changes: Every settings panel now uses the same layout: sources, then Models, LoRAs, Sampler and Advanced on the left; prompt, Generate and results on the right. Lists, sliders and prompt boxes are standardised: searchable model and LoRA lists filtered by model family, sliders with a manual field, and prompt boxes coloured by role. Lists and menus are released reliably after a generation, a stop or an error, and switching tabs no longer cancels a running job. The Studio Light theme is readable everywhere and the dark themes use dark text on accent buttons. The FLUX 1, Nunchaku, FLUX Krea and WAN 2.2 workflows were removed.
